title: How To Run A Tasting
intro: How to run a tasting is designed to assist participants in the understanding and execution of the necessary steps required to run a Lavazza Coffee tasting.
body: How to run a tasting is designed to assist participants in the understanding and execution of the necessary steps required to run a Lavazza Coffee tasting. Participants will use the skills they have gained in previous courses to dial in their grinders to a given espresso recipe, taste espresso to achieve a desired aroma and taste profile as well as explaining the flavors the customer is getting from the chosen coffee.. A detailed session will be given on storytelling and delivery of the Lavazza brand, its history and pinnacle moments within Lavazza’s’ journey. Participants will then deliver this as one seamless presentation, from start to finish.
topics: Learning How To Prepare A Coffee Tasting
Taking A Look At Coffee Profile Evaluation
Understanding How To Lead A Coffee Tasting Session

title: The Lavazza Foundation
intro: Covers the Lavazza Foundation’s key projects, linking them to specific coffee blends. Participants will learn how to discuss the foundation’s mission with customers.
body: The Lavazza Foundation course offers a deep dive into the origins and purpose of the Lavazza Foundation and its key projects. Three highlighted projects will be detailed, helping participants understand and articulate them to customers. The session includes tastings of blends linked to these initiatives and guidance on where to find further information on other foundation projects. Updates on existing programs will also be provided to enhance participants’ ability to discuss the foundation’s impact confidently.
topics: Learning About The Lavazza Foundation’s Mission
Gaining A Deep Knowledge Of Key Foundation Projects
Being Able To Link Coffee Blends to Programmes

title: Introduction to Coffee
intro: A beginner’s guide to coffee, from its Ethiopian origins to the brewing process. Participants will learn the journey of coffee and enjoy a cupping session to explore diverse flavours.
body: Introduction to Coffee is an ideal course for anyone new to the coffee industry or seeking a deeper understanding of coffee fundamentals. It traces coffee’s journey from its origins in Ethiopia to its status as a global commodity enjoyed worldwide. Participants will explore the stages from farming, drying, roasting, brewing, to tasting coffee. This half-day course includes a “coffee cupping” session, allowing participants to experience the diverse flavours coffee has to offer while understanding the processes involved.
topics: Discovering The History Of Coffee
Learning About The Stages Of Coffee Production
Understanding How To Discuss Coffee Tasting Notes

title: Foodservice Portfolio Deep Dive
intro: A detailed review of the foodservice coffee portfolio, focusing on product positioning, taste profiles, and their fit within the wider hospitality sector.
body: The Foodservice Portfolio Deep Dive provides a comprehensive exploration of the coffee portfolio within the foodservice sector. Participants will examine the composition, taste profile, and positioning of products, understanding how they fit into the broader hospitality landscape. This course offers a detailed analysis of how the portfolio meets specific market needs and the best ways to present and discuss it in a competitive environment.

title: Retail Portfolio Deep Dive
intro: Explore the retail coffee portfolio, comparing it with competitors to understand market positioning and strategy for retail success.
body: The Retail Portfolio Deep Dive explores the retail coffee portfolio and compares it against key competitors. This course provides essential knowledge for professionals aiming to understand market competition and communicate effectively about retail coffee products.

title: Understanding Foodservice Equipment & Extraction
intro: Learn about coffee extraction through demos and tastings. Explore equipment calibration and how to improve in-cup quality, covering the Lavazza 1895 range through to Classics.
body: This course is designed to deepen participants’ understanding of coffee extraction and its impact on brewing. Through demonstrations and tasting exercises, participants will experience how different extraction levels alter the flavour profile. The course covers the Lavazza 1895 range through to Lavazza Classics, teaching how these SKUs fit within the market. Participants will also learn how to run tastings, resolve on-site calibration issues, and improve in-cup quality using equipment specific to foodservice clients.
topics: Gaining An Understanding Of Coffee Extraction Theory
Being Able To Demonstrate The Impact Of Extraction On Flavour
Learning How To Calibrate And Troubleshoot Coffee Equipment

title: Understanding Domestic Equipment & Extraction
intro: Focuses on home brewing extraction techniques, with demonstrations across retail SKUs. Covers recipe recommendations and common troubleshooting for better coffee at home.
body: The Understanding Domestic Equipment & Extraction course focuses on coffee extraction techniques for home brewing. Participants will experience demonstrations and tastings across retail SKUs, learning how different extraction methods impact flavour. They will also gain knowledge on market positioning, recipe recommendations, and troubleshooting common customer issues, enhancing the overall home coffee experience. This course is perfect for those looking to improve coffee brewing at home or for retail clients.
topics: Gaining A Deep Understanding Of Home Brewing Extraction
Getting An Overview of Coffee Recipe Creation
Learning How To Troubleshoot Home Brewing Issues
